name: Dynamic Assist Companion
brief: Lets the Dynamic Assist browser extension query any table you can read, read-only.
description: The companion to the Dynamic Assist browser extension. It adds one page, Dynamic Assist Query, that the extension's query builder talks to: it lists tables and fields and runs read-only queries (filters, sort, row limit) as the signed-in user. Your permissions and security filters apply; nothing is written.
